in_marathi.name: Panavi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे All-knowing, Wise, Intelligent
in_marathi.long_meaning: Panavi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Panavi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘पानवि’, which means ‘one who knows everything’ or ‘all-knowing’. This name is associated with the goddess Saraswati, who is the embodiment of knowledge, wisdom, and art. It is a powerful and meaningful name for a baby girl in Hindu tradition.
